role.zh: 社会心理学、进化心理学

headline.zh: 我关注个体在面对与自身生存和安全相关的威胁时，如何理解并调整自己与国家、政府及其他群体之间的关系。
headline.en: I study how people understand and navigate their relationships with nations, governments, and other groups when facing threats to their survival and security.

bio.zh: 我的研究基于进化心理学视角，考察群体认同、制度信任与群体边界在威胁应对中的作用。
bio.en: My research draws on evolutionary psychology to examine the roles of group identification, institutional trust, and group boundaries in responses to threat.

bio.zh: 目前，我主要研究 AI 及其他现实威胁如何影响国家认同，以及政府信任在其中发挥的作用。在此基础上，我也希望将这条研究线拓展到社会文化变迁中的规范压力，进一步理解这类压力如何影响身份适应、社会联结和掌控感。
bio.en: My current work examines how AI-related and other realistic threats shape national identification, as well as the role of government trust in these processes. Building on this work, I also hope to extend this research to normative pressures amid sociocultural change and examine how such pressures shape identity adaptation, social connectedness, and perceived control.

bio.zh: 如果你也对这些问题感兴趣，或有合作想法，欢迎与我联系。(^-^)
bio.en: If these questions resonate with you, or if you have a collaboration idea, I would be glad to hear from you. (^-^)

title.zh: 人工智能威胁对国家认同的影响及其心理机制
title.en: AI Threat and National Identification: Psychological Mechanisms

question.zh: 本项目检验 AI 威胁是否削弱国家认同，并进一步考察政府信任能否解释或缓冲这一关系。
question.en: This project tests whether AI threat weakens national identification and whether government trust explains or buffers this relationship.

designData.zh: 基于跨国档案数据（N = 32,330）、问卷研究（N = 541）与行为实验（N = 600）开展多研究检验。
designData.en: A multi-study program using cross-national archival data (N = 32,330), a survey (N = 541), and a behavioral experiment (N = 600).

methods.zh: 采用 HLM 与中介路径分析，考察 AI 威胁、政府信任和国家认同之间的关系。
methods.en: HLM and mediation-path analyses examine relationships among AI threat, government trust, and national identification.

role.zh: 第一作者，负责文献梳理、理论框架建构、研究设计与执行、数据分析以及论文写作与修改。
role.en: First author; responsible for the literature review, theoretical framework, study design and implementation, data analysis, and manuscript preparation and revision.

title.zh: 现实威胁对国家认同的影响及其心理机制
title.en: Realistic Threat and National Identification: Psychological Mechanisms

question.zh: 本综述从进化心理学视角整合现实威胁与国家认同研究，区分国家依恋与国家群体界定，并探讨现实威胁如何改变不同认同形式在特定环境中的相对适应性价值，使国家认同的不同维度呈现不同变化。
question.en: This review integrates research on realistic threats and national identification through an evolutionary psychological lens. It distinguishes national attachment from national group definition and examines how threats may alter the relative adaptive value of different forms of national identification across environmental conditions, leading these dimensions to change in different ways.

designData.zh: 整合自然灾害、战争与恐怖袭击、传染病、经济衰退及移民威胁等研究证据。
designData.en: An integrative review of evidence on natural disasters, war and terrorism, infectious disease, economic downturn, and immigration threat.

methods.zh: 围绕安全寻求、保护性群体依赖、控制感修复、国家群体功能性价值评估与群际边界强化等机制构建综合解释框架。
methods.en: The framework synthesizes mechanisms including security seeking, protective group reliance, restoration of control, evaluation of the national group's functional value, and stronger intergroup boundaries.

role.zh: 负责核心概念辨析与理论框架建构，主导综述主体写作与多轮修改，并重点推进进化解释与适应性价值逻辑的完善。
role.en: Responsible for conceptual clarification and theoretical framework development; led the main review writing and successive revisions, with particular focus on refining the evolutionary account and adaptive-value logic.

title.zh: 中国大学新生强迫症状与元认知信念的纵向网络研究
title.en: Longitudinal Network Study of Obsessive-Compulsive Symptoms and Metacognitive Beliefs Among Chinese University Freshmen

question.zh: 本研究刻画强迫症状与元认知信念的跨时网络关系，识别具有时间预测意义的关键节点，并明确时间关联不能被直接解释为因果机制。
question.en: This study maps cross-lagged network relations between obsessive-compulsive symptoms and metacognitive beliefs, identifies temporally predictive nodes, and clarifies that temporal associations should not be interpreted as causal mechanisms.

designData.zh: 采用纵向数据与交叉滞后面板网络分析。
designData.en: Longitudinal data analyzed with a cross-lagged panel network approach.

methods.zh: 重点澄清时间关联与因果机制的解释边界，并讨论心理脆弱性、发展转折、临床启示、研究局限与未来方向。
methods.en: The interpretation distinguishes temporal associations from causal mechanisms and considers psychological vulnerability, developmental transitions, clinical implications, limitations, and future directions.

role.zh: 合作作者，参与论文修改与审稿意见回复，重点完善 Introduction 与 Discussion，优化理论逻辑、文献整合及纵向网络结果的解释。
role.en: Co-author; contributed to manuscript revision and responses to reviewer comments, with particular focus on strengthening the Introduction and Discussion, theoretical logic, literature integration, and interpretation of the longitudinal network results.

title.zh: 疾病防御动机与对外国人的行为：刻板印象的中介作用
title.en: Disease Defense Motivation and Behavior Toward Foreigners: The Mediating Role of Stereotypes

question.zh: 疾病防御动机如何通过刻板印象影响个体与不同国籍外国人的合作行为？
question.en: How does disease defense motivation shape cooperation with foreigners of different nationalities through stereotypes?

methods.zh: 两项行为实验（N = 300、N = 101）与一项问卷调查（N = 118），采用社会困境范式以及中介与调节分析。
methods.en: Two behavioral experiments (N = 300 and N = 101) and one survey (N = 118), using social dilemma paradigms and mediation and moderation analyses.

title.zh: 人们真的喜新厌旧吗？情境对物品新旧偏好的影响
title.en: Do People Really Prefer the New? Context and Preferences for New Versus Old Objects

question.zh: 人们是否普遍偏好新物品，情境线索如何调节新旧偏好？
question.en: Do people generally prefer new objects, and how do contextual cues moderate preferences for new versus old objects?

methods.zh: 本科毕业论文，独立完成四项实验（N = 389），包含基于反应时的内隐联想测验、调节分析与中介分析。
methods.en: Undergraduate thesis comprising four independently conducted experiments (N = 389), including a reaction-time-based implicit association test, moderation analysis, and mediation analysis.

summary.en: A cross-lagged panel network analysis of the longitudinal associations between obsessive-compulsive symptoms and metacognitive beliefs among Chinese college freshmen.

degree.zh: 应用心理硕士，社会心理学方向
degree.en: M.A. in Applied Psychology, Social Psychology

highlights.zh: 组织诊断与健康度调研：基于 BLM 模型设计问卷并主导汽车新技术研究院半年度组织健康度调研，回收 14,000 余份问卷（回收率 89%），访谈 92 名员工与管理者，分析组织问题并形成研究报告与改进建议。
highlights.en: Organizational diagnosis and health survey: Designed a BLM-based questionnaire and led a semiannual organizational health survey for the Automotive New Technology Research Institute, collecting more than 14,000 responses (89% response rate) and interviewing 92 employees and managers to diagnose organizational issues and recommend improvements.

highlights.zh: 组织盘点与信息化建设：主导季度组织盘点，审视 3,000 余个组织单元并优化盘点流程；推动信息化系统从 0 到 1 上线，提升数据可视化效率。
highlights.en: Organizational review and digitalization: Led quarterly reviews of more than 3,000 organizational units, improved the review process, and launched a new information system that increased data-visualization efficiency.

highlights.zh: 定量研究与数据分析：负责汽水音乐、抖音等产品的用户调研数据分析，处理 20,000 余份有效数据并使用 SPSS 开展 TGI 等分析，为产品迭代与品牌升级提供洞察。
highlights.en: Quantitative research and data analysis: Analyzed user research data for products including Soda Music and Douyin, working with more than 20,000 valid responses and using SPSS for TGI and related analyses to inform product iteration and brand development.

highlights.zh: 定性研究与深度访谈：支持今日头条、番茄小说等产品的用户留存与功能研究，协助开展 50 余场用户访谈与焦点小组，提炼行为模式与核心痛点并提出可落地建议。
highlights.en: Qualitative research and in-depth interviews: Supported retention and feature research for products including Toutiao and Tomato Novel, contributing to more than 50 user interviews and focus groups and translating behavioral patterns and pain points into actionable recommendations.

highlights.zh: 市场与竞品分析：完成抖音“毕业歌会”与 B 站竞品对比，以及美国小说与短剧市场可行性研究；结合问卷（N = 1,000）与定性访谈梳理用户链路，为业务决策提供研究支持。
highlights.en: Market and competitive analysis: Conducted comparative research on Douyin's Graduation Concert and Bilibili, as well as feasibility research on the US fiction and short-drama markets; combined a survey (N = 1,000) with qualitative interviews to map user journeys and support business decisions.

highlights.zh: 参与中文版开放学术术语数据集项目。负责数据论文撰写，参与术语数据的整理。
highlights.en: Contributing to the Chinese-language Open Scholarship Glossary dataset project; responsible for drafting the data paper and contributing to terminology-data organization.

organization.zh: 追问 nextquestion（天桥脑科学研究院旗下科学媒体）
organization.en: nextquestion, Tianqiao and Chrissy Chen Institute

highlights.zh: 跟进人工智能、心理学、认知科学等领域的研究进展，进行资料整理、科普内容编译与撰写，累计发布 40 余篇科普文章。
highlights.en: Tracked research developments in artificial intelligence, psychology, and cognitive science; conducted background research and translated, adapted, and wrote popular science content, publishing more than 40 articles.

highlights.zh: 参与认知神经科学、心理学等领域期刊及杂志科普文章的编译与审校，累计推出 9 篇以上编译科普文章。
highlights.en: Translated, adapted, and reviewed popular science articles from journals and magazines in cognitive neuroscience, psychology, and related fields, contributing to more than nine published pieces.

highlights.zh: 参与神经现实官方微信公众号“神经周周发”栏目内容生产，累计推出 4 篇原创科普短文，从专业视角解读社会热点，为入门读者普及相关学科知识。
highlights.en: Contributed to NeuroReality's WeChat column Neuroscience Weekly and published four original short articles that used disciplinary perspectives to explain current social issues to introductory audiences.
